proposals: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish every LPG distributor-commission revision order as a text-searchable document and link it from PPAC's commission page, so whether ₹73.08 is still current can be confirmed from the order itself rather than a scanned image.

PPAC should state on its commission page whether commercial 19kg LPG carries a regulated distributor commission and, if so, its current rate and revision history, so the full LPG margin picture is published alongside the domestic 14.2kg and 5kg rates.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish annual totals of distributor commission paid on domestic LPG, split between Ujjwala and other connections, with average refills for each, so pools like the ₹3,642 crore estimated for Ujjwala refills are official figures, not outside calculations.

NPCI should publish UPI transaction value by merchant category, showing LPG distributors and fuel retail outlets separately, so any discussion of a merchant discount rate on these counters can start from UPI's actual share of their payments.

The Ministry of Finance should list, in any notification that introduces a UPI merchant discount rate, the merchant categories covered and state whether household LPG refills are included, so distributors know whether a 7.76 per cent margin is exposed before the fee takes effect.
